Yes, that works the way I'd expect. I clicked "+ Add tag," typed "Cooking," pressed Enter, and now the tag shows up right there on the bookmark. Adding my own free-form words directly on the item is exactly what I had in mind.

Two things I want to make sure we get to as we go — not blocking this, just so they're on your radar:

- I'd want a bookmark to be able to hold more than one tag, not just a single one. Like a link could be both "Cooking" and "Italian."
- And when I'm typing a tag I've used before, I'd love it to suggest my existing tags so I don't accidentally make "cooking" and "Cooking" as two separate ones.

But the basic add-a-tag behavior here is right. Good to keep going.
